{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the exact values to capture them
print('Mean flipper length by species:')
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print('\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length:')
print(highest_mean_species)

# Extract and print the mean value
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()
print('\nHighest mean flipper length:')
print(highest_mean_value)"}
